mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates restrictive monetary policy that suppresses corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and decline in unemployment rate below 4.5% signals an overheating economy where monetary tightening fails to cool demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE falling) occurs but SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a monthly payroll employment growth above 200k signals robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 4.0%, SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months indicates strengthening residential investment and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed $380 billion in a month, it signals strong consumer spending that accelerates corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of periods when RSAFS > 380.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past two months indicates robust manufacturing output and supply chain stability, supporting corporate profit margins and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 annual growth > 2.5%), a deceleration in quarterly GDP growth below 1.5% signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods (GDPC1 annual growth > 2.5%), SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in less than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth decelerates below 1.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
